title: Everyday English Word Quest A1–A2
description: Build practical A1–A2 vocabulary in definitions and real usage contexts for school, home, food, feelings, actions, and places.

units.title: Daily Foundations
units.description: Useful vocabulary for school, home, and meals.

lessons.title: School
lessons.description: Learn 10 English words through definitions, sentence context, and precise usage.

challenges.question: Which word means “a learner who is enrolled in an educational institution”?
challenges.explanation: “student” means a learner who is enrolled in an educational institution. Example: The student asked a thoughtful question during the lesson.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “The _____ explained the new idea with a clear example.”
challenges.explanation: “teacher” means a person whose occupation is teaching. Example: The teacher explained the new idea with a clear example.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “The _____ became quiet when the lesson began.”
challenges.explanation: “classroom” means a room in a school where lessons take place. Example: The classroom became quiet when the lesson began.

challenges.question: Which word means “a unit of instruction”?
challenges.explanation: “lesson” means a unit of instruction. Example: Today's lesson introduces the water cycle.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “I finished my _____ before dinner.”
challenges.explanation: “homework” means preparatory school work done outside school (especially at home). Example: I finished my homework before dinner.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “We borrowed two science books from the _____.”
challenges.explanation: “library” means a room where books are kept. Example: We borrowed two science books from the library.

challenges.question: Which word means “a thin cylindrical pointed writing implement”?
challenges.explanation: “pencil” means a thin cylindrical pointed writing implement. Example: Use a pencil so you can correct your work easily.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “She recorded each new word in her _____.”
challenges.explanation: “notebook” means a book with blank pages for recording notes or memoranda. Example: She recorded each new word in her notebook.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Mina raised her hand to ask a _____.”
challenges.explanation: “question” means a sentence or request that asks for information. Example: Mina raised her hand to ask a question.

challenges.question: Which word means “a reply to a question or a solution to a problem”?
challenges.explanation: “answer” means a reply to a question or a solution to a problem. Example: Check your answer before submitting the worksheet.

lessons.title: Home
lessons.description: Learn 10 English words through definitions, sentence context, and precise usage.

challenges.question: Which word means “a social unit living together”?
challenges.explanation: “family” means a social unit living together. Example: Her family eats dinner together every Friday.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “A _____ signed the school permission form.”
challenges.explanation: “parent” means a mother, father, or person who cares for a child. Example: A parent signed the school permission form.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “The _____ read the short story aloud.”
challenges.explanation: “child” means a young person of either sex. Example: The child read the short story aloud.

challenges.question: Which word means “a room equipped for preparing meals”?
challenges.explanation: “kitchen” means a room equipped for preparing meals. Example: We prepared breakfast together in the kitchen.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “He opened the _____ window to let in fresh air.”
challenges.explanation: “bedroom” means a room used primarily for sleeping. Example: He opened the bedroom window to let in fresh air.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Sunlight came through the classroom _____.”
challenges.explanation: “window” means a framework of wood or metal that contains a glass windowpane and is built into a wall or roof to admit light or air. Example: Sunlight came through the classroom window.

challenges.question: Which word means “a piece of land where flowers, fruit, or vegetables are grown”?
challenges.explanation: “garden” means a piece of land where flowers, fruit, or vegetables are grown. Example: The students planted herbs in the school garden.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “A healthy _____ can help learners concentrate.”
challenges.explanation: “breakfast” means the first meal of the day (usually in the morning). Example: A healthy breakfast can help learners concentrate.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “We talked about our day during _____.”
challenges.explanation: “dinner” means the main meal of the day served in the evening or at midday. Example: We talked about our day during dinner.

challenges.question: Which word means “received with pleasure or friendly approval”?
challenges.explanation: “welcome” means received with pleasure or friendly approval. Example: The new student received a warm welcome.

lessons.title: Food and Drink
lessons.description: Learn 10 English words through definitions, sentence context, and precise usage.

challenges.question: Which word means “fruit with red or yellow or green skin and sweet to tart crisp whitish flesh”?
challenges.explanation: “apple” means fruit with red or yellow or green skin and sweet to tart crisp whitish flesh. Example: She packed an apple for her morning snack.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “The _____ was ripe and sweet.”
challenges.explanation: “banana” means elongated crescent-shaped yellow fruit with soft sweet flesh. Example: The banana was ripe and sweet.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “He made a sandwich with fresh _____.”
challenges.explanation: “bread” means food made from dough of flour or meal and usually raised with yeast or baking powder and then baked. Example: He made a sandwich with fresh bread.

challenges.question: Which word means “grains used as food either unpolished or more often polished”?
challenges.explanation: “rice” means grains used as food either unpolished or more often polished. Example: The family served vegetables with rice.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “Remember to drink enough _____ after exercise.”
challenges.explanation: “water” means a clear liquid that people, animals, and plants need to live. Example: Remember to drink enough water after exercise.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “The cafe also serves tea and _____.”
challenges.explanation: “coffee” means a dark drink made from roasted beans. Example: The cafe also serves tea and coffee.

challenges.question: Which word means “edible seeds or roots or stems or leaves or bulbs or tubers or nonsweet fruits of any of numerous herbaceous plant”?
challenges.explanation: “vegetable” means edible seeds or roots or stems or leaves or bulbs or tubers or nonsweet fruits of any of numerous herbaceous plant. Example: Carrots are the vegetable in today's soup.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “I felt _____ after the football match.”
challenges.explanation: “hungry” means needing or wanting food. Example: I felt hungry after the football match.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “The vegetable soup smelled _____.”
challenges.explanation: “delicious” means having a very pleasant taste or smell. Example: The vegetable soup smelled delicious.

challenges.question: Which word means “directions for making something”?
challenges.explanation: “recipe” means directions for making something. Example: The recipe explains how to prepare the dish step by step.

units.title: People on the Move
units.description: Words for actions, emotions, and getting around.

lessons.title: Actions
lessons.description: Learn 10 English words through definitions, sentence context, and precise usage.

challenges.question: Which word means “the act of traveling by foot”?
challenges.explanation: “walk” means the act of traveling by foot. Example: We walk to the library after lunch.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “Please _____ clearly during your presentation.”
challenges.explanation: “speak” means to use your voice to say words. Example: Please speak clearly during your presentation.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “_____ carefully for the main idea.”
challenges.explanation: “listen” means hear with intention. Example: Listen carefully for the main idea.

challenges.question: Which word means “to form words or symbols on a surface”?
challenges.explanation: “write” means to form words or symbols on a surface. Example: Write your name at the top of the page.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “This bag can _____ all of my school books.”
challenges.explanation: “carry” means to hold and move something from one place to another. Example: This bag can carry all of my school books.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Please _____ your book to page ten.”
challenges.explanation: “open” means to move something so that it is no longer closed. Example: Please open your book to page ten.

challenges.question: Which word means “to shut an opening or bring something to an end”?
challenges.explanation: “close” means to shut an opening or bring something to an end. Example: Close the door quietly when you leave.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “The assembly will _____ at nine o'clock.”
challenges.explanation: “begin” means to start doing or being something. Example: The assembly will begin at nine o'clock.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Try to _____ the activity before the bell.”
challenges.explanation: “finish” means to complete something or reach its end. Example: Try to finish the activity before the bell.

challenges.question: Which word means “select as an alternative over another”?
challenges.explanation: “choose” means select as an alternative over another. Example: Choose the strongest evidence for your answer.

lessons.title: Feelings and Character
lessons.description: Learn 10 English words through definitions, sentence context, and precise usage.

challenges.question: Which word means “enjoying or showing or marked by joy or pleasure”?
challenges.explanation: “happy” means enjoying or showing or marked by joy or pleasure. Example: The class felt happy about its progress.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “The ending of the story made him feel _____.”
challenges.explanation: “sad” means experiencing or showing sorrow or unhappiness. Example: The ending of the story made him feel sad.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “She felt _____ when the rule was applied unfairly.”
challenges.explanation: “angry” means feeling or showing anger. Example: She felt angry when the rule was applied unfairly.

challenges.question: Which word means “feeling fear or worry”?
challenges.explanation: “afraid” means feeling fear or worry. Example: He was afraid to speak until his partner encouraged him.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “The students felt _____ about the class trip.”
challenges.explanation: “excited” means very enthusiastic and eager. Example: The students felt excited about the class trip.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “After the long journey, everyone felt _____.”
challenges.explanation: “tired” means in need of rest or sleep. Example: After the long journey, everyone felt tired.

challenges.question: Which word means “peaceful and not excited, worried, or upset”?
challenges.explanation: “calm” means peaceful and not excited, worried, or upset. Example: She stayed calm and followed the safety instructions.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “The students were _____ of their community project.”
challenges.explanation: “proud” means feeling self-respect or pleasure in something by which you measure your self-worth. Example: The students were proud of their community project.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “It was _____ of you to help the new learner.”
challenges.explanation: “kind” means friendly, generous, and considerate toward others. Example: It was kind of you to help the new learner.

challenges.question: Which word means “ready to face danger or difficulty with courage”?
challenges.explanation: “brave” means ready to face danger or difficulty with courage. Example: The brave student admitted the mistake and corrected it.

lessons.title: Around Town
lessons.description: Learn 10 English words through definitions, sentence context, and precise usage.

challenges.question: Which word means “a health facility where patients receive treatment”?
challenges.explanation: “hospital” means a health facility where patients receive treatment. Example: The ambulance carried the patient to the hospital.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “Farmers sell fresh produce at the weekend _____.”
challenges.explanation: “market” means a place where people buy and sell goods. Example: Farmers sell fresh produce at the weekend market.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “The train arrived at the _____ on time.”
challenges.explanation: “station” means a place where trains or buses regularly stop. Example: The train arrived at the station on time.

challenges.question: Which word means “an airfield equipped with control tower and hangars as well as accommodations for passengers and cargo”?
challenges.explanation: “airport” means an airfield equipped with control tower and hangars as well as accommodations for passengers and cargo. Example: We arrived at the airport two hours before the flight.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “The family reserved a table at the _____.”
challenges.explanation: “restaurant” means a building where people go to eat. Example: The family reserved a table at the restaurant.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Use the crossing when you walk across the _____.”
challenges.explanation: “street” means a thoroughfare (usually including sidewalks) that is lined with buildings. Example: Use the crossing when you walk across the street.

challenges.question: Which word means “a structure carrying a path or road over an obstacle”?
challenges.explanation: “bridge” means a structure carrying a path or road over an obstacle. Example: The bridge connects the village to the main road.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “The small _____ has a school and a health clinic.”
challenges.explanation: “village” means a community of people smaller than a town. Example: The small village has a school and a health clinic.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Their long _____ ended safely at the village.”
challenges.explanation: “journey” means the act of traveling from one place to another. Example: Their long journey ended safely at the village.

challenges.question: Which word means “a commercial document showing that the holder is entitled to something (as to ride on public transportation or to enter a public entertainment)”?
challenges.explanation: “ticket” means a commercial document showing that the holder is entitled to something (as to ride on public transportation or to enter a public entertainment). Example: Keep your bus ticket until the end of the journey.

title: Academic English Word Quest B1–B2
description: Practise high-value B1–B2 words in definitions and real usage contexts from research, writing, science, mathematics, and society.

units.title: Study and Research
units.description: Words for thinking, evidence, reading, and writing.

lessons.title: Thinking Skills
lessons.description: Learn 10 English words through definitions, sentence context, and precise usage.

challenges.question: Which word means “consider in detail and subject to an analysis in order to discover essential features or meaning”?
challenges.explanation: “analyze” means consider in detail and subject to an analysis in order to discover essential features or meaning. Example: Students analyze the results before writing a conclusion.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “_____ the two articles and identify their similarities.”
challenges.explanation: “compare” means examine and note the similarities or differences of. Example: Compare the two articles and identify their similarities.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “The essay will _____ city life with village life.”
challenges.explanation: “contrast” means put in opposition to show or emphasize differences. Example: The essay will contrast city life with village life.

challenges.question: Which word means “form a critical opinion of”?
challenges.explanation: “evaluate” means form a critical opinion of. Example: Researchers evaluate whether the method produced reliable results.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “Use the diagram to _____ how the machine works.”
challenges.explanation: “explain” means make plain and comprehensible. Example: Use the diagram to explain how the machine works.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Readers _____ the character's feelings from clues in the story.”
challenges.explanation: “infer” means to reach a conclusion from evidence and reasoning. Example: Readers infer the character's feelings from clues in the story.

challenges.question: Which word means “to explain or understand the meaning of something”?
challenges.explanation: “interpret” means to explain or understand the meaning of something. Example: The class will interpret the information shown in the graph.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “Scientists _____ the plant each day and record any changes.”
challenges.explanation: “observe” means to notice or watch something carefully. Example: Scientists observe the plant each day and record any changes.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Scientists _____ tomorrow's weather using current data.”
challenges.explanation: “predict” means to say what is likely to happen in the future. Example: Scientists predict tomorrow's weather using current data.

challenges.question: Which word means “to give the main points in a shorter form”?
challenges.explanation: “summarize” means to give the main points in a shorter form. Example: Summarize the passage in three clear sentences.

lessons.title: Evidence and Research
lessons.description: Learn 10 English words through definitions, sentence context, and precise usage.

challenges.question: Which word means “your basis for belief or disbelief”?
challenges.explanation: “evidence” means your basis for belief or disbelief. Example: The writer supports the claim with evidence from the text.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “Their _____ examines how sleep affects learning.”
challenges.explanation: “research” means systematic investigation to establish facts. Example: Their research examines how sleep affects learning.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Always check whether an online _____ is trustworthy.”
challenges.explanation: “source” means the place, person, or thing from which information comes. Example: Always check whether an online source is trustworthy.

challenges.question: Which word means “a collection of facts from which conclusions may be drawn”?
challenges.explanation: “data” means a collection of facts from which conclusions may be drawn. Example: The class organized its survey data in a table.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “The researcher explained the _____ used in the experiment.”
challenges.explanation: “method” means a way of doing something, especially a systematic way. Example: The researcher explained the method used in the experiment.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “The final _____ matched the team's prediction.”
challenges.explanation: “result” means the outcome produced by an action or event. Example: The final result matched the team's prediction.

challenges.question: Which word means “a well-substantiated explanation of some aspect of the natural world”?
challenges.explanation: “theory” means a well-substantiated explanation of some aspect of the natural world. Example: The evidence supports the theory presented in the article.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “The student council conducted a _____ about school lunches.”
challenges.explanation: “survey” means a detailed critical inspection. Example: The student council conducted a survey about school lunches.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “The laboratory tested a small _____ of river water.”
challenges.explanation: “sample” means a small part chosen to represent a larger whole. Example: The laboratory tested a small sample of river water.

challenges.question: Which word means “a judgment or decision reached after reasoning”?
challenges.explanation: “conclusion” means a judgment or decision reached after reasoning. Example: The conclusion explains what the experiment demonstrated.

lessons.title: Reading and Writing
lessons.description: Learn 10 English words through definitions, sentence context, and precise usage.

challenges.question: Which word means “a fact or assertion offered as evidence that something is true”?
challenges.explanation: “argument” means a fact or assertion offered as evidence that something is true. Example: A strong argument includes reasons and supporting evidence.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “Each _____ should develop one clear main idea.”
challenges.explanation: “paragraph” means one of several distinct subdivisions of a text intended to separate ideas. Example: Each paragraph should develop one clear main idea.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Each _____ should express a complete idea.”
challenges.explanation: “sentence” means a string of words satisfying the grammatical rules of a language. Example: Each sentence should express a complete idea.

challenges.question: Which word means “discourse that surrounds a language unit and helps to determine its interpretation”?
challenges.explanation: “context” means discourse that surrounds a language unit and helps to determine its interpretation. Example: The surrounding paragraph provides context for the unfamiliar word.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “Use a short _____ to support your interpretation.”
challenges.explanation: “quotation” means a passage or expression that is quoted or cited. Example: Use a short quotation to support your interpretation.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “The report includes a _____ for every borrowed idea.”
challenges.explanation: “reference” means a source used to find or support information. Example: The report includes a reference for every borrowed idea.

challenges.question: Which word means “make revisions in”?
challenges.explanation: “revise” means make revisions in. Example: Writers revise their drafts to make the meaning clearer.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “Her first _____ contained several ideas to develop.”
challenges.explanation: “draft” means an early version of a piece of writing. Example: Her first draft contained several ideas to develop.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Careful _____ makes formal writing easier to understand.”
challenges.explanation: “grammar” means the branch of linguistics that deals with syntax and morphology (and sometimes also deals with semantics). Example: Careful grammar makes formal writing easier to understand.

challenges.question: Which word means “a listing of the words used in some enterprise”?
challenges.explanation: “vocabulary” means a listing of the words used in some enterprise. Example: Reading widely can expand your academic vocabulary.

units.title: STEM and Society
units.description: Academic vocabulary across technical and social subjects.

lessons.title: Science
lessons.description: Learn 10 English words through definitions, sentence context, and precise usage.

challenges.question: Which word means “the ability to do work or cause change”?
challenges.explanation: “energy” means the ability to do work or cause change. Example: Solar panels convert sunlight into energy.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “All _____ has mass and occupies space.”
challenges.explanation: “matter” means physical substance from which things are made. Example: All matter has mass and occupies space.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Oxygen is an _____ found in air and water.”
challenges.explanation: “element” means a pure substance made from one kind of atom. Example: Oxygen is an element found in air and water.

challenges.question: Which word means “a living thing that has (or can develop) the ability to act or function independently”?
challenges.explanation: “organism” means a living thing that has (or can develop) the ability to act or function independently. Example: Each organism depends on its environment to survive.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “The region's _____ is warm and humid throughout the year.”
challenges.explanation: “climate” means the weather in some location averaged over some long period of time. Example: The region's climate is warm and humid throughout the year.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Recycling can reduce harm to the _____.”
challenges.explanation: “environment” means the totality of surrounding conditions. Example: Recycling can reduce harm to the environment.

challenges.question: Which word means “a scientific test used to discover or demonstrate something”?
challenges.explanation: “experiment” means a scientific test used to discover or demonstrate something. Example: The experiment tests how light affects plant growth.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “The scientist changed one _____ at a time.”
challenges.explanation: “variable” means a factor that can change or be changed. Example: The scientist changed one variable at a time.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Use a ruler to _____ the length of the leaf.”
challenges.explanation: “measure” means to find the size, amount, or degree of something. Example: Use a ruler to measure the length of the leaf.

challenges.question: Which word means “a series of actions that produces a result”?
challenges.explanation: “process” means a series of actions that produces a result. Example: Photosynthesis is the process plants use to make food.

lessons.title: Mathematics
lessons.description: Learn 10 English words through definitions, sentence context, and precise usage.

challenges.question: Which word means “a mathematical statement that two expressions are equal”?
challenges.explanation: “equation” means a mathematical statement that two expressions are equal. Example: Solve the equation to find the unknown value.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “One half is a _____ that represents one of two equal parts.”
challenges.explanation: “fraction” means a number representing part of a whole. Example: One half is a fraction that represents one of two equal parts.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Write one half as the _____ 0.5.”
challenges.explanation: “decimal” means a number written with a point to show a fraction of ten. Example: Write one half as the decimal 0.5.

challenges.question: Which word means “the relative magnitudes of two quantities (usually expressed as a quotient)”?
challenges.explanation: “ratio” means the relative magnitudes of two quantities (usually expressed as a quotient). Example: The ratio of blue cards to red cards is two to one.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “The _____ of four, six, and eight is six.”
challenges.explanation: “average” means a value found by adding numbers and dividing by how many there are. Example: The average of four, six, and eight is six.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “In _____, students study shapes, angles, and space.”
challenges.explanation: “geometry” means the pure mathematics of points and lines and curves and surfaces. Example: In geometry, students study shapes, angles, and space.

challenges.question: Which word means “make a mathematical calculation or computation”?
challenges.explanation: “calculate” means make a mathematical calculation or computation. Example: Use the measurements to calculate the area of the room.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “Make an _____ before calculating the exact total.”
challenges.explanation: “estimate” means an approximate calculation of quantity or degree or worth. Example: Make an estimate before calculating the exact total.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Place the events in the correct _____.”
challenges.explanation: “sequence” means a set of things arranged in a particular order. Example: Place the events in the correct sequence.

challenges.question: Which word means “a repeated or regular arrangement”?
challenges.explanation: “pattern” means a repeated or regular arrangement. Example: The number pattern increases by three each time.

lessons.title: Society
lessons.description: Learn 10 English words through definitions, sentence context, and precise usage.

challenges.question: Which word means “the shared ideas, customs, and arts of a group”?
challenges.explanation: “culture” means the shared ideas, customs, and arts of a group. Example: Food, language, and art are important parts of culture.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “The _____ worked together to clean the park.”
challenges.explanation: “community” means a group of people living in a particular local area. Example: The community worked together to clean the park.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Small businesses contribute to the local _____.”
challenges.explanation: “economy” means the system of production and distribution and consumption. Example: Small businesses contribute to the local economy.

challenges.question: Which word means “the organization that is the governing authority of a political unit”?
challenges.explanation: “government” means the organization that is the governing authority of a political unit. Example: The government introduced a new education policy.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “The court aims to deliver _____ fairly.”
challenges.explanation: “justice” means the quality of being just or fair. Example: The court aims to deliver justice fairly.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Seasonal _____ brings the birds back each spring.”
challenges.explanation: “migration” means the movement of persons from one country or locality to another. Example: Seasonal migration brings the birds back each spring.

challenges.question: Which word means “the people who inhabit a territory or state”?
challenges.explanation: “population” means the people who inhabit a territory or state. Example: The town's population has grown over the last decade.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “Sharing this meal is an important family _____.”
challenges.explanation: “tradition” means an inherited pattern of thought or action. Example: Sharing this meal is an important family tradition.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Every _____ has both rights and responsibilities.”
challenges.explanation: “citizen” means a native or naturalized member of a state or other political community. Example: Every citizen has both rights and responsibilities.

challenges.question: Which word means “the study or record of past events”?
challenges.explanation: “history” means the study or record of past events. Example: The museum preserves objects from local history.

title: English Word Power C1
description: Strengthen C1 vocabulary through precise definitions and real usage contexts for communication, problem-solving, change, and the wider world.

units.title: Expression and Growth
units.description: Words for character, communication, and positive change.

lessons.title: Character
lessons.description: Learn 10 English words through definitions, sentence context, and precise usage.

challenges.question: Which word means “capable of adapting (of becoming or being made suitable) to a particular situation or use”?
challenges.explanation: “adaptable” means capable of adapting (of becoming or being made suitable) to a particular situation or use. Example: An adaptable learner can use different study strategies.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “The class set an _____ goal for its reading challenge.”
challenges.explanation: “ambitious” means having a strong desire for success or achievement. Example: The class set an ambitious goal for its reading challenge.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Practice helped her feel _____ during the presentation.”
challenges.explanation: “confident” means having or marked by confidence or assurance. Example: Practice helped her feel confident during the presentation.

challenges.question: Which word means “eager to know or learn something”?
challenges.explanation: “curious” means eager to know or learn something. Example: A curious student asks questions and explores new ideas.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “His _____ research uncovered several useful sources.”
challenges.explanation: “diligent” means quietly and steadily persevering especially in detail or exactness. Example: His diligent research uncovered several useful sources.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “The _____ volunteers shared their time and skills.”
challenges.explanation: “generous” means willing to give and share unstintingly. Example: The generous volunteers shared their time and skills.

challenges.question: Which word means “not disposed to cheat or defraud”?
challenges.explanation: “honest” means not disposed to cheat or defraud. Example: Give an honest account of what happened.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “The tutor remained _____ while the learner tried again.”
challenges.explanation: “patient” means enduring trying circumstances with even temper or characterized by such endurance. Example: The tutor remained patient while the learner tried again.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “A _____ source provides accurate, verifiable information.”
challenges.explanation: “reliable” means worthy of reliance or trust. Example: A reliable source provides accurate, verifiable information.

challenges.question: Which word means “recovering readily from adversity, depression, or the like”?
challenges.explanation: “resilient” means recovering readily from adversity, depression, or the like. Example: The resilient team recovered from its early setback.

lessons.title: Communication
lessons.description: Learn 10 English words through definitions, sentence context, and precise usage.

challenges.question: Which word means “expressing yourself easily or characterized by clear expressive language”?
challenges.explanation: “articulate” means expressing yourself easily or characterized by clear expressive language. Example: Her articulate response communicated a complex idea clearly.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “Ask a follow-up question to _____ the instructions.”
challenges.explanation: “clarify” means make clear and (more) comprehensible. Example: Ask a follow-up question to clarify the instructions.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “The two classes _____ on a community garden project.”
challenges.explanation: “collaborate” means to work together toward a shared goal. Example: The two classes collaborate on a community garden project.

challenges.question: Which word means “expressing much in few words”?
challenges.explanation: “concise” means expressing much in few words. Example: A concise summary includes only the most important points.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “Students _____ whether the proposed solution is fair.”
challenges.explanation: “debate” means the formal presentation of a stated proposition and the opposition to it (usually followed by a vote). Example: Students debate whether the proposed solution is fair.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Please _____ what you observed during the experiment.”
challenges.explanation: “describe” means give a description of. Example: Please describe what you observed during the experiment.

challenges.question: Which word means “to consider or examine in speech or writing”?
challenges.explanation: “discuss” means to consider or examine in speech or writing. Example: The group will discuss the evidence before making a decision.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “The campaign aims to _____ students to save water.”
challenges.explanation: “persuade” means cause somebody to adopt a certain position, belief, or course of action. Example: The campaign aims to persuade students to save water.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Please _____ to the question with a complete sentence.”
challenges.explanation: “respond” means to reply or react to something. Example: Please respond to the question with a complete sentence.

challenges.question: Which word means “restate (words) from one language into another language”?
challenges.explanation: “translate” means restate (words) from one language into another language. Example: Can you translate this short message into English?

lessons.title: Change
lessons.description: Learn 10 English words through definitions, sentence context, and precise usage.

challenges.question: Which word means “cause to move faster”?
challenges.explanation: “accelerate” means cause to move faster. Example: New tools can accelerate the research process.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “The group will _____ its plan after reviewing the feedback.”
challenges.explanation: “adapt” means make fit for, or change to suit a new purpose. Example: The group will adapt its plan after reviewing the feedback.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Students _____ stronger arguments through careful revision.”
challenges.explanation: “develop” means to grow or change into a more advanced form. Example: Students develop stronger arguments through careful revision.

challenges.question: Which word means “come out into view, as from concealment”?
challenges.explanation: “emerge” means come out into view, as from concealment. Example: New themes emerge as the class examines the interviews.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “Add evidence to _____ the second paragraph.”
challenges.explanation: “expand” means extend in one or more directions. Example: Add evidence to expand the second paragraph.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Regular feedback can _____ the quality of a first draft.”
challenges.explanation: “improve” means to make or become better. Example: Regular feedback can improve the quality of a first draft.

challenges.question: Which word means “to introduce new ideas or methods”?
challenges.explanation: “innovate” means to introduce new ideas or methods. Example: Engineers innovate when existing solutions no longer work.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “Turning off unused lights can _____ energy consumption.”
challenges.explanation: “reduce” means to make something smaller or less. Example: Turning off unused lights can reduce energy consumption.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Heat can _____ ice into liquid water.”
challenges.explanation: “transform” means to change greatly in form, appearance, or character. Example: Heat can transform ice into liquid water.

challenges.question: Which word means “a change from one place or state or subject or stage to another”?
challenges.explanation: “transition” means a change from one place or state or subject or stage to another. Example: A linking phrase creates a smooth transition between ideas.

units.title: Solutions and the World
units.description: Precise words for challenges, decisions, and global topics.

lessons.title: Challenges and Solutions
lessons.description: Learn 10 English words through definitions, sentence context, and precise usage.

challenges.question: Which word means “complicated in structure”?
challenges.explanation: “complex” means complicated in structure. Example: The team divided the complex problem into smaller steps.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “The mediator helped both sides resolve the _____.”
challenges.explanation: “conflict” means a serious disagreement or struggle. Example: The mediator helped both sides resolve the conflict.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Soil erosion can be a _____ of removing too many trees.”
challenges.explanation: “consequence” means a result or effect of an action. Example: Soil erosion can be a consequence of removing too many trees.

challenges.question: Which word means “something immaterial that stands in the way and must be circumvented or surmounted”?
challenges.explanation: “obstacle” means something immaterial that stands in the way and must be circumvented or surmounted. Example: Limited transport was an obstacle to attending the event.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “The container cracked when the internal _____ became too high.”
challenges.explanation: “pressure” means a difficult demand or feeling of urgency. Example: The container cracked when the internal pressure became too high.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Student safety is the school's highest _____.”
challenges.explanation: “priority” means something considered more important than other things. Example: Student safety is the school's highest priority.

challenges.question: Which word means “an answer to a problem or difficult situation”?
challenges.explanation: “solution” means an answer to a problem or difficult situation. Example: The group tested more than one solution to the problem.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “The team developed a _____ for completing the project on time.”
challenges.explanation: “strategy” means a carefully planned method for achieving a goal. Example: The team developed a strategy for completing the project on time.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Teams _____ when members communicate and share responsibility.”
challenges.explanation: “succeed” means attain success or reach a desired goal. Example: Teams succeed when members communicate and share responsibility.

challenges.question: Which word means “compelling immediate action”?
challenges.explanation: “urgent” means compelling immediate action. Example: The broken water pipe required urgent attention.

lessons.title: Precision
lessons.description: Learn 10 English words through definitions, sentence context, and precise usage.

challenges.question: Which word means “conforming exactly or almost exactly to fact or to a standard or performing with total accuracy”?
challenges.explanation: “accurate” means conforming exactly or almost exactly to fact or to a standard or performing with total accuracy. Example: The report must include accurate measurements.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “The map shows the _____ location of the campsite.”
challenges.explanation: “approximate” means not quite exact or correct. Example: The map shows the approximate location of the campsite.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Her results were _____ across all three trials.”
challenges.explanation: “consistent” means the same throughout in structure or composition. Example: Her results were consistent across all three trials.

challenges.question: Which word means “(often followed by `from') not alike”?
challenges.explanation: “distinct” means (often followed by `from') not alike. Example: The two materials have distinct properties.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “The new system is more _____ and uses less energy.”
challenges.explanation: “efficient” means being effective without wasting time or effort or expense. Example: The new system is more efficient and uses less energy.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Clean water is _____ for human health.”
challenges.explanation: “essential” means absolutely necessary. Example: Clean water is essential for human health.

challenges.question: Which word means “capable of being changed”?
challenges.explanation: “flexible” means capable of being changed. Example: A flexible schedule can accommodate unexpected changes.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “The study found a _____ improvement in attendance.”
challenges.explanation: “significant” means important in effect or meaning. Example: The study found a significant improvement in attendance.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Use a _____ example to support your claim.”
challenges.explanation: “specific” means stated explicitly or in detail. Example: Use a specific example to support your claim.

challenges.question: Which word means “based on sound reasoning or officially acceptable”?
challenges.explanation: “valid” means based on sound reasoning or officially acceptable. Example: The conclusion is valid because it follows from the evidence.

lessons.title: Our World
lessons.description: Learn 10 English words through definitions, sentence context, and precise usage.

challenges.question: Which word means “a system formed by the interaction of a community of organisms with their physical environment”?
challenges.explanation: “ecosystem” means a system formed by the interaction of a community of organisms with their physical environment. Example: A healthy wetland ecosystem supports many species.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “Water _____ helps communities prepare for dry seasons.”
challenges.explanation: “conservation” means the protection of nature and careful use of resources. Example: Water conservation helps communities prepare for dry seasons.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “In a _____, citizens choose representatives through elections.”
challenges.explanation: “democracy” means the political orientation of those who favor government by the people or by their elected representatives. Example: In a democracy, citizens choose representatives through elections.

challenges.question: Which word means “the quality of being the same in quantity or measure or value or status”?
challenges.explanation: “equality” means the quality of being the same in quantity or measure or value or status. Example: The policy promotes equality by giving every learner the same opportunity.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “Climate change is a _____ challenge.”
challenges.explanation: “global” means relating to the whole world. Example: Climate change is a global challenge.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “Reliable transport _____ connects rural communities to cities.”
challenges.explanation: “infrastructure” means the basic systems and structures a society or organization needs. Example: Reliable transport infrastructure connects rural communities to cities.

challenges.question: Which word means “able to continue without using up resources or harming the environment”?
challenges.explanation: “sustainable” means able to continue without using up resources or harming the environment. Example: The school chose a sustainable design that uses less energy.

challenges.question: Complete this sentence: “Assistive _____ can make learning more accessible.”
challenges.explanation: “technology” means scientific knowledge and tools used to solve practical problems. Example: Assistive technology can make learning more accessible.

challenges.question: Choose the most precise word for this sentence: “The city created more green spaces in _____ neighborhoods.”
challenges.explanation: “urban” means relating to or concerned with a city or densely populated area. Example: The city created more green spaces in urban neighborhoods.

challenges.question: Which word means “the health, happiness, and safety of a person or group”?
challenges.explanation: “welfare” means the health, happiness, and safety of a person or group. Example: The organization protects the welfare of children and families.
